title: The Akedah — Genesis 22:8 and John 8:56
summary: Genesis 22:8, under the title 'The Akedah' (העקדה) in red: Abraham tells his son that God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, and the two walk on together. Below it, John 8:56 has Jesus saying Abraham rejoiced to see His day. 'Abraham' is blue, 'God' blue, red and gold, 'lamb' grey, 'son' red, and 'My' red.

text.text: 8 Abraham said, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” So the two of them walked on together.
56 “Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day, and he saw it and was glad.”
